name: TripJack — OTA Extractor
description: Reads hotel name, dates, occupancy and room/price straight from the OTA tab you have open (real, logged-in session), fetches the matching TripJack price, drops a comparison card right next to the OTA's own price on the page, and lets the user book the matched rate over WhatsApp with a configurable markup.

action.default_title: Fetch TripJack price for this page
